title: Milestone 1 · Hold a complete selection
baseline: Baseline: approved starter 81dfa9f (page + health; 2 smoke tests)

columns.title: Booking client
columns.detail: A terminal caller selects seats and retains the returned reservation ID.

columns.title: Keep a party together
columns.detail: Obtain every selected seat, or leave the entire selection unreserved.

columns.title: Hold a complete selection
columns.today: Only a page and health check.
columns.detail: Inspect availability, request a group, and recover its reservation by ID.

columns.title: All or nothing
columns.detail: If A3 is held, reject A2+A3 without claiming A2 or creating a partial hold.

columns.title: Exclusive seat ownership
columns.detail: Two clients requesting B1 cannot both receive successful holds.

columns.title: Recover an accepted hold
columns.detail: A3+A4 and their returned ID survive process restarts. One screening, twelve seats.

columns.title: Educational example
columns.detail: Explore design through a terminal JSON service; no payments or customer accounts.

columns.title: Movie Seats API
columns.detail: Expose JSON operations to the booking client; retain the original health contract.

columns.title: Reservation service
columns.detail: Validate selection and make one transaction decide the complete outcome.

columns.title: SQLite engine
columns.detail: Serialize writes and enforce unique claims; rollback a failed allocation.

columns.title: HTTP worker
columns.detail: Use an independent connection per operation; never share mutable connections.

columns.title: Competing HTTP workers
columns.detail: Coordinate through the same local SQLite file, including separate processes.

columns.title: Service operator
columns.detail: Retain the file selected by MOVIE_SEATS_DB when restarting Uvicorn.

columns.title: Uvicorn process
columns.detail: The existing app factory remains the server entry point on one local host.

columns.title: app.py
columns.detail: Initialize the store during startup, register the API, and expose it on app.state.

columns.title: domain.py
columns.detail: Reject empty, duplicate or unknown seats; canonicalize order without hiding mistakes.

columns.title: db.py · Store
columns.detail: BEGIN IMMEDIATE, check all requested claims, insert reservation and claims, then COMMIT.

columns.title: api.py
columns.detail: Translate domain errors to stable JSON; distinguish invalid, missing, conflict and busy.

columns.title: db.py · connection scope
columns.detail: Close each connection; bounded lock wait; rollback on every failed transaction.

columns.title: db.py · recovery
columns.detail: Create version 1 atomically; refuse unknown schemas; look up committed holds on a new connection.

columns.title: Page and health handlers
columns.detail: Retain the starter page and process health response while adding booking routes.

columns.title: GET /screening
columns.detail: Return screening-1 and A1–C4 with available/held status in a consistent snapshot.

columns.title: POST /reservations
columns.detail: Body: seats, 1–12 unique known strings. Reject extra fields and malformed JSON with 422.

columns.title: Reservation response
columns.detail: 201 returns id, canonical seats and held status, only after the transaction commits.

columns.title: Failure response
columns.detail: 422 invalid; 404 unknown ID; 409 seats unavailable; 503 busy, Retry-After: 1.

columns.title: Concurrent creation
columns.detail: The successful commit owns B1. The losing request receives 409 after checking claims.

columns.title: GET /reservations/{id}
columns.detail: Return the original group and state after restart; no retry deduplication yet.

columns.title: GET /health
columns.detail: 200 with status=ok and service=movie-seats remains available.

columns.title: Screening inventory
columns.detail: Seed exactly A1–A4, B1–B4 and C1–C4. Availability is derived from current claims.

columns.title: Requested seat set
columns.detail: Immutable reservation_seats rows retain the original group independently of claims.

columns.title: Reservation identity
columns.detail: UUID primary key and held status, committed together with every selected seat.

columns.title: Transaction effects
columns.detail: Any conflict or write failure leaves neither a partial hold nor partial ownership.

columns.title: Seat claims
columns.detail: seat is the primary key; foreign keys bind claims to a known seat and reservation.

columns.title: Versioned database file
columns.detail: instance/movie-seats.sqlite3 by default; user_version=1 and atomic initialization.

columns.title: Process health value
columns.detail: Computed response, not a promise that a particular booking request will succeed.

columns.title: Screening + smoke checks
columns.detail: Preserve them; assert all twelve seats and correct held/available views.

columns.title: Selection checks
columns.detail: Empty, duplicates, unknown IDs, nonstrings, extra fields and malformed body all fail.

columns.title: Creation checks
columns.detail: A3+A4 returns one ID; a separate Store and HTTP lookup recover the exact selection.

columns.title: Rollback checks
columns.detail: A2+A3 clash leaves A2 free; an injected SQL failure leaves zero partial rows.

columns.title: Contention checks
columns.detail: Barrier-start two Store instances on B1: one success, one conflict. Busy lock -> 503.

columns.title: Stop / restart scenario
columns.detail: Real Uvicorn processes, same file: recover A3+A4; reject overlap; race B1 over HTTP.

columns.title: Starter smoke checks
columns.detail: The page still opens; the exact health response remains unchanged.

nodes.title: Booking client
nodes.detail: POST A3+A4. Keep the returned ID for later lookup.

nodes.title: Movie Seats API
nodes.detail: Parse the request. Call validation, then allocation. Translate failures to HTTP.

nodes.title: Selection policy
nodes.detail: Known, unique seat IDs; no empty group. Canonical order does not change meaning.

nodes.title: Reservation service
nodes.detail: BEGIN IMMEDIATE; check all claims; insert ID, selection and claims; COMMIT before 201.

nodes.title: SQLite engine
nodes.detail: Primary keys enforce exclusive claims. Rollback failures. A new process reads the same file.

notes: SUCCESS · Commit A3+A4 under one UUID, then return 201. A later GET recovers the same group from the file.
CONFLICT · A3 already held: POST A2+A3 returns 409. Neither a partial reservation nor a claim on A2 survives.
COMPETITION · BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes independent writers. After the first commit, the second sees B1 claimed.
RECOVERY LIMIT · A lost creation response remains ambiguous without its ID. Safe creation retries belong to milestone 2.
PROPOSED ACCEPTANCE · Real stop/restart preserves A3+A4; an overlap fails; concurrent HTTP requests produce one B1 winner.

summary: One screening. Group atomicity and exclusivity are service guarantees. Availability is a snapshot, not a promise that a later hold will succeed.
